title: Clean and sanitize food-contact work surface
prep: Remove food and loose debris; move product away from work area.
steps: Wash surface with approved cleaner; remove soil and residue.
sanitize: Rinse if required, apply approved food-contact sanitizer, allow required contact time, air dry.
verification: Surface is visibly clean, no food/grease residue, sanitizer step completed.
safety: Keep food protected from chemical splash.

title: Clean dish / stewarding work area
prep: Remove racks, scraps and loose debris.
steps: Wash accessible exterior surfaces, tables and surrounding splash areas.
sanitize: Rinse/sanitize surfaces as appropriate and allow to dry.
verification: No visible food soil, buildup or standing debris.
safety: Follow equipment shutdown and chemical handling rules.

title: Clean kitchen floors
steps: Apply approved floor cleaner, scrub edges/corners and traffic areas, squeegee/mop clean.
sanitize: Rinse as required and leave floor dry enough for safe traffic.
verification: No loose debris, grease film or pooled water.

title: Clean floor drains
prep: Remove loose debris with designated tools.
steps: Clean cover and surrounding area; remove visible buildup.
sanitize: Rinse and apply approved sanitizer/deodorizer if applicable.
verification: No visible food debris or slime around accessible drain surfaces.

title: Daily walk-in upkeep
prep: Protect stored food; remove spills and loose debris.
steps: Wipe accessible surfaces and clean spills immediately; straighten storage.
verification: No spills/debris; storage remains organized and off floor.
safety: Keep doors closed as much as practical.

title: Daily dry-storage floor cleanup
prep: Move loose cartons/items as needed without blocking access.
steps: Sweep floor and edges; remove trash and cardboard.
sanitize: No sanitizer required unless contamination occurred.
verification: Floor and corners free of loose debris; aisles clear.
safety: Maintain clear access and safe stacking.

title: Clean beneath / behind equipment
prep: Shut down or move equipment safely as required; protect nearby food.
steps: Remove debris and grease from floor, wall and equipment exterior/legs/casters.
sanitize: Rinse/sanitize any food-contact surfaces disturbed during work.
verification: No accumulated grease, food or trash in accessible hidden areas.
safety: Do not move equipment unsafely; use help where needed.

title: Deep clean walk-in shelving and walls
prep: Work one section at a time; protect or relocate food.
steps: Remove loose soil, wash shelves/walls/door surfaces, clean corners and ledges.
sanitize: Rinse/sanitize food-contact shelving as required; dry before restocking.
verification: No buildup, spills or residue; food returned in organized condition.

title: Wash kitchen wall soil areas
steps: Degrease/wash visible splash and soil areas from bottom to top as appropriate.
verification: No visible grease streaks or food splash.

title: High dust / vent surface cleaning
prep: Protect food and work surfaces below.
steps: Remove dust/grease from accessible high surfaces using designated tools.
sanitize: Clean any debris that falls onto lower surfaces; sanitize food-contact surfaces if affected.
verification: No visible dust or loose buildup.

title: Clean storage shelving
prep: Empty one section at a time; inspect product condition.
steps: Remove debris, wash shelves and supports, clean floor beneath.
sanitize: Sanitize if required for the surface/use; dry before restocking.
verification: Shelving dry, clean, organized; no loose debris.
safety: Do not place product back on wet shelving.
